up: Retrieve approved drugs from ChEMBL (molecule_dictionary) that are in clinical phase 4 (max_phase = 4) and have records in both drug_mechanism and compound_structures tables. For each such drug, provide the following columns: chembl_id (drug ChEMBL ID), pref_name (drug preferred name), canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (target ChEMBL ID from target_dictionary), target_name (target preferred name from target_dictionary). Enforce inner join from molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and inner join from molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, and left join from drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid. Ensure that canonical_smiles is not null. Return distinct rows for exactly these eight columns. Do not include any other columns.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, md.max_phase, dm.mechanism_of_action, dm.action_type, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
